Inside Macintosh: Macintosh Human Interface Guidelines / Part 2 - The Interface Elements
Chapter 8 - Icons / Default and Custom Icons

Preferences Icons

Many applications have preferences files that store information about a user's preferences. If you supply this file or create one after the user stores settings for your application or documents, you'll need to create an icon for it. Preferences files icons often contain document icons with radio buttons,
as shown in Figure 8-40.
